root.label: Iran submits proposal to Washington through Qatar

events.label: Iran submits proposal to Washington through Qatar

slots.name: frozen funds
slots.sentence: Iranian authorities say the proposal calls for an end to fighting, the lifting of the US blockade on Iranian ports, the release of at least $12 billion in frozen Iranian funds and a waiver of oil sanctions.

slots.name: conditions count
slots.sentence: Iranian sources said Washington wants Iran's disputed nuclear programme included in negotiations, but Tehran insists that the nuclear talks can only begin after its seven conditions are met, not before.

slots.name: hostilities halt timeline
slots.sentence: At last week's United Nations General Assembly in New York, Tehran submitted a proposal to Washington through Qatari mediators that, if accepted, could reopen the Strait of Hormuz and halt hostilities across the region within seven days.

slots.name: proposal outcome
slots.sentence: President Donald Trump rejected Iran's proposal for peace Saturday.
